correctness.rationale: PASS: For alpha>1, stationary equilibrium renewal age A_R/R has normalized density (alpha-1)/alpha on (0,1) and (alpha-1)/alpha*u^(-alpha) for u>=1. Conditioned on age, SSEP one-point density solves heat equation and converges to h(y,u)=0.5 erfc(y/(2 sqrt u)). The two-point connected-correlation generator has negative adjacent-particle forcing equal to minus the square of the gradient. The reflected gap heat kernel and Duhamel bound give uniform O((1+log(1+t))/sqrt(1+t)) decay of conditional pair covariances. Dominated convergence yields Cov(h(y,U),h(z,U)). Strict monotonicity for y positive/negative gives the stated sign across or within sides; conditional negative association bounds macroscopic block-average fluctuations and proves joint L2 convergence. Independent numerical integration reproduces +/-0.0182786826692 at alpha=3/2; finite checks are corroboration, not proof of limits.
